title: Inter: Lautaro and Thuram are back. Should Lautaro start at Atalanta?
caption:
Inter's Lautaro Martínez and Marcus Thuram trained with the group on Tuesday, per Sky Sport Italia — Lautaro's first session with the group since his injury. Tuttosport says Chivu won't rush him, and Thuram could start next to Pio Esposito. We say the captain starts in Bergamo. Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.
